items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: the famous Charlie Parker, who I admired, believe me, he was influenced by Jimmy Dorsey.

ctx.x: And he had a sound that was fairly identifiable.

Yeah. A lot of guys didn’t like his quiver. But now, that was a beautiful thing. Now I have to tell you something, the famous Charlie Parker, who I admired, believe me, he was influenced by Jimmy Dorsey. Did you know this Spiegle?
